limitations: PDS Search API documentation warns that the registry is not fully populated; zero results do not prove the archive lacks data.
Review product labels, instrument calibration, coordinate system, units, spatial coverage, version and licence before processing.
Binary ingestion is a separate step; do not interpret metadata as measurements.
